resources.string: HEXFORGE operates exclusively on offline single-player games installed on your own device for personal, private, non-commercial use. Online, competitive, and server-authoritative games are strictly refused by Gatekeeper (PD-1). No copyrighted game binaries are ever distributed.
You tick what you want unlimited — the engine figures out HOW.
No root. Shizuku optional. Your games, your device, your rules.
Every single step is explained, reported, and reversible.
OFFLINE games only. Online/competitive targets are refused, always.
